_about: Real datasets transcribed from the lecture PDFs for the Visualize tools (supplemental). Each entry cites the page it was copied from; tests/unit/stats.test.ts recomputes the lecture's own quartiles, fences, whiskers and five-number summaries from these values.

datasets.title: Example 6.4.1 — Site II
datasets.note: Lecture result: Q1 = 13, Q2 = 17.5, Q3 = 21, IQR = 8. The value 1 sits exactly on the lower inner fence, so it is a mild outlier. Left-skewed.

datasets.title: Example 6.4.1 — Site I
datasets.note: Lecture result: Q1 = 13.5, Q2 = 19, Q3 = 29, no outliers. Right-skewed. The lecture says the textbook's stem-and-leaf plot for this site (p. 207) has an error; the values here are the ordered data printed in the notes.

datasets.title: Example 6.4.2 (n = 21, three outliers)
datasets.note: Read from the lecture's stem-and-leaf plot (stem = tens, leaf = ones). Lecture result: Q1 = 32, Q2 = 40, Q3 = 47; 8 and 89 are mild outliers, 108 is extreme; whiskers 12 and 61.

datasets.title: Quartiles, odd n (2, 8, 9, 10, 17, 18, 35)
datasets.note: The median 10 is included in both halves: Q1 = 8.5, Q3 = 17.5. 35 is a mild outlier.

datasets.title: Quartiles, even n (1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 18)
datasets.note: Lecture result: Q2 = 7.5, Q1 = 5, Q3 = 10, IQR = 5.

datasets.title: Variance example (1, 4, 6, 9, 10)
datasets.note: Mean 6, s² = 13.5, s ≈ 3.6742, median 6, range 9 (as worked in the content-pack lesson).

datasets.title: Resistance: 1, 2, 3, 4, 50
datasets.note: Replacing 5 by 50 moves the mean from 3 to 12 but the median stays 3.

datasets.title: Aug 24 stem-and-leaf values (34 leaves as printed)
datasets.note: Stem = hundredths, leaf = thousandths. The printed display has 34 leaves but the frequency table on the same page has 35 observations (one in [0.07, 0.08)). Both are kept as printed; no value is invented.

grouped.title: Aug 24 frequency table (grouped, n = 35)
grouped.note: Only class counts are given, so quartiles and boxplots cannot be computed. Classes are [lo, hi): 0.03 belongs to [0.03, 0.04).

categorical.title: Political-party affiliation (n = 40)
categorical.note: Lecture result: relative frequencies 0.325, 0.45, 0.225; pie slices 117°, 162°, 81°.
